hack.category: Lending / Money Market (Compound fork — Fuse isolated pools)
hack.root_cause: Re-entrancy via `exitMarket()` in Compound fork missing check-effects-interaction pattern
hack.description: Rari Capital's Fuse isolated lending pools lost $80M to a re-entrancy attack exploiting a gap in their Compound fork's `exitMarket()` function — a vulnerability class that had already drained CREAM, Hundred, and Rari's own Fuse pools months earlier.
